evidence.text:
For every coprime pair m>n>=1, the polynomial in Edholm–Mathew Conjecture 4.20 has no root on the unit circle and exactly m-n roots in the punctured unit disc, counted with multiplicity. A finite coefficient reindexing gives a sum of squared floor-polynomial values, and an adjacent-polynomial difference makes it strictly positive.
